sources.title: yu314-coder/typhoon-predict - GitHub
sources.snippet: Typhoon Predict Typhoon Predict is an ERA5-conditioned tropical-cyclone track research model. It combines recent storm-track history with a local atmospheric reanalysis patch and produces a probabilistic forecast at multiple lead times. This repository contains a trained PyTorch checkpoint and a portable inference script.
